title: A Parallel Multi-Dialect Arabic Dependency Treebank
abstract: arXiv:2610.28823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dependency parsing resource development for Arabic has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving dialectal Arabic comparatively under-resourced. We introduce MADARTB, the first large-scale parallel dependency treebank spanning five city dialects: Beirut, Cairo, Doha, Rabat and Tunis, and extending an existing parallel MSA version. In total MADARTB consists of 5,000 sentences annotated using the CATiB dependency scheme. We analyze syntactic similarity across all city dialects and MSA. Although global construction profiles exhibit high similarity across varieties, local syntactic structures frequently diverge, revealing substantial structural variation across dialects. We further establish a cross-dialect dependency parsing comparison using a supervised parser and four LLMs. The supervised parser achieves 87.5% LAS, while the best LLM setup trails at 85.7% LAS across all six varieties on the test set. translated_title: 一个平行多方言阿拉伯语依存树库
translated_abstract: 阿拉伯语依存句法分析资源的开发长期以来主要集中在现代标准阿拉伯语上，导致方言阿拉伯语的资源相对匮乏。我们介绍了MADARTB，这是首个覆盖五种城市方言（贝鲁特、开罗、多哈、拉巴特和突尼斯）的大规模平行依存树库，它扩展了现有的平行现代标准阿拉伯语版本。MADARTB总共包含5,000个句子，采用CATiB依存标注方案进行标注。我们分析了所有城市方言与现代标准阿拉伯语之间的句法相似性。尽管各变体的整体构式特征表现出高度相似性，但局部句法结构经常出现分歧，揭示了方言之间显著的结构差异。我们进一步使用有监督解析器和四个大语言模型建立了跨方言依存句法分析的比较。在测试集上，有监督解析器在所有六个变体上达到了87.5%的LAS，而最佳的大语言模型配置则以85.7%的LAS落后。我们发布了我们的标注（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发布了首个涵盖五种城市方言的平行阿拉伯语依存树库MADARTB（共5000个句子），揭示了各方言与标准阿拉伯语整体句法相似但局部结构差异显著，并通过实验表明有监督解析器（87.5% LAS）在跨方言依存分析上优于最佳的大语言模型（85.7% LAS）。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MADARTB, the first large-scale parallel Arabic dependency treebank spanning five city dialects with 5,000 sentences, revealing that while global syntactic profiles are similar across varieties, local structures diverge substantially, and showing that a supervised parser (87.5% LAS) outperforms the best LLM setup (85.7% LAS) in cross-dialect dependency parsing.
